lessons_note: Assertion hygiene: a JSON-filter test must target the field the value actually lives in (candidate .name here, not .description) — otherwise `... | length -eq 0` is vacuously true and cannot catch a regression. Verify a negative test can fail by feeding it the positive fixture.
